name: @pipeworx/mcp-france-geodata

tools.name: fr_commune
tools.description: French commune lookup (Etalab/INSEE commune register): INSEE code, postcodes, population, department, region, centre point and area. Look up by name or INSEE code, or pass lat+lon to find the commune containing a point. Example: "population of Lyon" -> 69123, 519,127.

name.description: Commune name, e.g. "Lyon". Returns the best matches.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84); pair with lon to find the commune at a point.

limit.description: Max communes for a name search, 1-20 (default 5).

tools.name: fr_buildings_near
tools.description: Buildings within a radius (max 500 m) of a point in France, from the IGN BD TOPO building layer. Each building has GeoJSON polygon geometry, height (m), floors, dwellings, use, nature and construction dates. Reports the total matched and flags truncation. Use for "buildings within 200 m of X" and GeoJSON export of them.

include_geometry.description: Include polygon geometry (default true). Set false for attributes only.

tools.name: fr_land_cover
tools.description: Land cover at a point in mainland France: the CORINE Land Cover 2018 class (code and label, e.g. 112 "Discontinuous urban fabric") of the polygon containing the point, with its area. Resolution is 25 ha mapping units, so it describes the surrounding area, not the exact spot. found:false when the point is outside the coverage (sea, abroad, overseas).

tools.name: fr_flood_zones
tools.description: Flood-risk information around a point in France from Géorisques (French Ministry of Ecological Transition): the flood hazards recorded for the commune at the point, the flood-zone atlases (AZI) covering communes within the radius, and any significant-flood-risk territory (TRI) in range. These are risk-record listings, not parcel-level flood polygons, so absence of a record is not proof of no flood risk.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-france-geodata forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the france-geodata pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
